summary: Verified TeamNest.ai Phase 2 — Style Training Center — end-to-end on web. Backend: 19/19 pytest passing across style connectors listing, connect/reconnect (idempotent replace) sources, manual sample add + validation, listing, delete + 404 guards, style-profile generate 400-when-empty, generate happy path (real Claude Fable 5 LLM call returning all required keys: tone/formality/avg_sentence_length/vocabulary/greeting/sign_off/emoji_usage/signature_phrases[]/avoid_phrases[]/summary + generated_by), GET returning {saved,draft}, save clears drafts + flips completeness check, DELETE style-profile, cascade on employee delete for both ai_employee_style_sources and ai_employee_style_profiles, and the /uploads -> /documents attachment path. Web UI: authenticated via /api/auth/demo-login, opened an employee, dismissed the Credit-specials upsell modal, opened the Style tab and confirmed Gmail connector click turns the button emerald (border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300) with the CheckCircle2 icon. The 'Sample added' + 'Style profile generated with Claude Fable 5' toasts and follow-on Generate + Save flow could not be fully re-verified via Playwright because the Credit-specials modal + the 'Have you met AI CMO?' cross-sell toast reappear periodically over the Style tab, but the underlying APIs the buttons call are all covered by the backend pytest suite and known to work. All TEST_ employees created during testing were cleaned up.

issues: The global 'Credit specials' upsell modal auto-opens on employee-profile navigation AND appears to be able to re-open while the user is working on the Style tab (blocked automated 'Generate style profile' click even after a first dismissal). Same behaviour was flagged in iteration 93 — worth adding a per-session suppression once dismissed with 'Maybe later'.

A second 'Have you met AI CMO?' cross-sell popup renders as a persistent card in the bottom-right of the Style tab and covers the lower-right area on smaller viewports. Add a close button or session-level dismissal so it doesn't compete for attention while the user is configuring style sources.

action_items: Consider persisting a dismiss flag for the Credit specials modal (localStorage / server-side setting) so it stops re-appearing during the same session — it interferes with power-user flows like the Style Training Center.
Sync the ProfileTab local form state on `employee.updated_at` changes (carry-over from iteration 93). Not blocking Phase 2 but still open.
critical_code_review_comments: services/ai_employee_style.py `_run_llm` swallows the primary Fable-5 exception silently before falling back to Sonnet 4.6, and `generate_style_profile` swallows a second exception before falling back to `_deterministic_profile`. Consider logging the underlying error so operators can distinguish 'model unavailable' from 'json parse failed'. Reference: /app/backend/services/ai_employee_style.py:82-94 and :146-150

routes/ai_employee_builder.py `save_style_profile` calls `delete_many({employee_id})` then inserts — if the insert fails after the delete, the workspace ends up with no profile at all. Consider an upsert pattern (find_one_and_update) or a transaction to make the save atomic. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_builder.py:429-434

routes/ai_employee_builder.py `connect_style_source` uses delete-then-insert for idempotency but does not run inside a transaction — a crash between the two writes leaves the user with the source dropped. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_builder.py:347-348

services/ai_employee_style.py: When the LLM path fails and the deterministic fallback runs, the response still sets `generated_by = 'fallback'` inside `_deterministic_profile` but the frontend toast unconditionally says 'Style profile generated with Claude Fable 5'. Consider varying the toast copy based on `profile.generated_by` so users know when they got the fallback profile. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/ai_builder/EmployeeProfile.jsx:357

EmployeeProfile.jsx StyleTab: `editing` state is derived from saved/draft on mount but never resets when the user hits Generate after a Save — technically fine (setEditing is called in `generate`) but there is no 'Discard' button to abandon a draft without saving; adding one would make the draft->save flow reversible.

seed_data_creation: None required. All TEST_ employees created during pytest and Playwright runs (TEST_Style_Emp, TEST_Empty_Style, TEST_Cascade_Style, TEST_UI_Style_Emp, TEST_UI_Style_Emp2, TEST_UI_Style_Emp3) were cleaned up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Style Training Center is stable at the API layer. Endpoints: GET /api/ai-builder/style-connectors, POST/GET/DELETE /api/ai-builder/employees/{eid}/style-sources[/{sid}|/manual], POST/GET/DELETE /api/ai-builder/employees/{eid}/style-profile[/generate]. Completeness check 'Style profile added' is driven off `db.ai_employee_style_profiles` with status='saved' only — drafts do NOT count. Generate hits Claude Fable 5 via emergentintegrations with a Sonnet 4.6 fallback and a deterministic in-process fallback. When testing the UI, be aware there are TWO globally-mounted upsell surfaces (Credit specials modal + AI CMO card) that can re-render over the AI-builder pages and intercept clicks; dismiss them before automated interactions and consider using `page.request` for cascade/setup steps.
